phase: Phase 1: Photo checks, then the remaining fixes
summary: The diff 40419d4bc..d43334ba6 matches spec AC-1 through AC-4. The e2e fails on a photo a reader cannot see, both workflow wirings gate a www push and a www deploy, and the Green fixes uncover the photos and keep the picture ratios. Three nonblocking findings stay open, and one layout deviation is accepted.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Medium] The AC-1 aspect and short-side assertion skips two product pictures. photos.spec.ts:590-613 keeps only photos with a program-card-* or product-block-* ancestor. The Tutor picture (tutor-advantage.tsx:71-76) and the report-results picture (b2b-solutions.tsx:351-358) have no such ancestor, so a future squeeze of the Tutor picture would pass the gate. Both use ratio-preserving h-auto w-full today, and the same portrait class is aspect-checked in the three program cards. Fix by adding a testid or by extending the loop to /images/products/ sources.

F2 [Low] The exclusion code skips two cases beyond the spec list. photos.spec.ts:147 skips an empty src, and photos.spec.ts:155 skips a path segment that starts with qr, logo, or icon. A real photo named icon-guide.png would escape every check, while spec AC-1 allows only the listed rules.

F3 [Low] Plan task 1.1 keeps a stale proof line. The checked-off text claims a failing run at 8193625ca^ for hero and product photos, while the body of the same task says the pre-fix e2e was skipped. The Red evidence at HEAD is real, and the hero unit test fails at 8193625ca^.

D1 [Accepted deviation] The See How We Report Results card stays stacked at every width. Spec AC-4 asked for a side-by-side layout from lg. The grid is md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 (b2b-solutions.tsx:216), so the cell is one third wide at lg and a side-by-side layout would shrink the photo. The stacked card keeps text off the photo, which is the owner complaint, and the plan records the deviation.
